[[File:Tan-Divo-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Tan Divo was a police inspector on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
{{Quote|After all, I'm the inspector, you're the Senator, so I'll handle the inspecting, and you can stick to the&hellip; the ''Senating''.|Tan Divo, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
'''Inspector''' was a rank or title given to individuals who worked for civilian [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police agencies]]. Often they were responsible for solving crimes and bringing the perpetrators in so that they could face justice, sometimes having to cross vast stretches of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to do so. [[Hal Horn]] was an inspector for the [[Corellian Security Force]] up until his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. [[Lorz Geptun]] was an inspector for the [[Judicial Service]]. In the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], if [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] were of a higher rank than [[Detective/Legends|Detective]], they would be referred to by both their rank and as an inspector as in the case of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]].
